rules.statement: A tenant cannot dispute his landlord's title and must first give up possession before litigating about ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even though the ownership of one half of this land were in the defendant himself, it would seem that by our law, having been let into possession of the whole by the plaintiff, it is not open to him to refuse to give up possession to his lessor at the expiration of his lease. He must first give up possession, and then it will be open to him to litigate about the ownership"
